hook.name: GeodeHook
hook.description: GeodeHook implements a permanent bonding curve venue on Uniswap v4. Direct swaps execute instantly against a constant-product curve via beforeSwap (0.3% fee split three ways), while gasless EIP-712-signed intents are settled in MEV-protected batches at a uniform clearing price (0.1% fee). The curve is the permanent market maker with no graduation or migration.
